cases.name: recursive self contract is a declared nominal refinement
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} class E implements Has.<E>{get():E{return this;}} String(Reflect.isAssignable(E,Has.<E>));

cases.name: a self contract admits typed assignment
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} class E implements Has.<E>{get():E{return this;}} const x:Has.<E>=new E();String(x.get() instanceof E);

cases.name: a named class expression preserves its recursive refinement
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} const C=class E implements Has.<E>{get():E{return this;}};String(Reflect.isAssignable(C,Has.<C>));

cases.name: a forward alias preserves a recursive refinement
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} type Alias=E;class E implements Has.<E>{get():E{return this;}} String(Reflect.isAssignable(Alias,Has.<E>));

cases.name: an interface alias preserves a recursive refinement
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} type Alias<T:type>=Has.<T>;class E implements Alias.<E>{get():E{return this;}}String(Reflect.isAssignable(E,Has.<E>));

cases.name: a subclass retains its inherited implementation arguments
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} class E implements Has.<E>{get():E{return this;}} class D extends E{}String(Reflect.isAssignable(D,Has.<E>))+"|"+String(Reflect.isAssignable(D,Has.<D>));

cases.name: a recursive generic class retains concrete application identity
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} class E<T:type> implements Has.<E.<T>>{get():E.<T>{return this;}}String(Reflect.isAssignable(type E.<uint8>,Has.<E.<uint8>>))+"|"+String(Reflect.isAssignable(type E.<uint8>,Has.<E.<string>>));

cases.name: ordinary generic arguments remain invariant
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} class E<T:type> implements Has.<T>{value:T;constructor(v:T){this.value=v;}get():T{return this.value;}}String(Reflect.isAssignable(type E.<uint8>,Has.<uint8>))+"|"+String(Reflect.isAssignable(type E.<uint8>,Has.<string>));

cases.name: matching member shape does not establish a declared relationship
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} class E{get():E{return this;}}String(Reflect.isAssignable(E,Has.<E>))+"|"+String(new E() is Has.<E>);

cases.name: an undeclared shape does not match a dependent callable bound
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} class E{get():E{return this;}}function choose<T:type>():string{return "base";}function choose<const V extends Has.<V>>():string{return "case";}choose.<E>();

cases.name: independent class and interface activations remain distinct
cases.source: function make(){interface I<T:type>{get():T;}class E implements I.<E>{get():E{return this;}}return {E,I:I.<E>};}const a=make(),b=make();String(Reflect.isAssignable(a.E,a.I))+"|"+String(Reflect.isAssignable(b.E,b.I))+"|"+String(Reflect.isAssignable(a.E,b.I))+"|"+String(Reflect.isAssignable(b.E,a.I));

cases.name: independent interface activations with equal arguments remain distinct
cases.source: function make(){interface I<T:type>{get():T;}class E implements I.<uint8>{get():uint8{return 1;}}return {E,I:I.<uint8>};}const a=make(),b=make();String(Reflect.isAssignable(a.E,a.I))+"|"+String(Reflect.isAssignable(b.E,b.I))+"|"+String(Reflect.isAssignable(a.E,b.I))+"|"+String(Reflect.isAssignable(b.E,a.I));

cases.name: separate classes from one outer interface retain self arguments
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} function make(){class E implements Has.<E>{get():E{return this;}}return E;}const A=make(),B=make();String(Reflect.isAssignable(A,Has.<A>))+"|"+String(Reflect.isAssignable(B,Has.<B>))+"|"+String(Reflect.isAssignable(A,Has.<B>));

cases.name: warm reflection never executes constructors or methods
cases.source: let count=0;interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} class E implements Has.<E>{constructor(){count+=1;}get():E{count+=10;return this;}}const a=Reflect.isAssignable(E,Has.<E>);const b=Reflect.isAssignable(E,Has.<E>);String(a)+"|"+String(b)+"|"+String(count);

cases.name: conditional class contribution follows the declared self bound
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} class E implements Has.<E>{get():E{return this;}} class Box<T:type>{}partial class Box<const V extends Has.<V>>{yes():string{return "yes";}}new Box.<E>().yes();

cases.name: callable selection follows the declared self bound
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} class E implements Has.<E>{get():E{return this;}} function choose<T:type>():string{return "base";}function choose<const V extends Has.<V>>():string{return "case";}choose.<E>();

cases.name: a wrong invariant argument does not match a callable bound
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} class E implements Has.<E>{get():E{return this;}} class Other{}function choose<T:type>():string{return "base";}function choose<const V extends Has.<Other>>():string{return "case";}choose.<E>();

cases.name: a member body still checks its declared result at runtime
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} function erased(v:any){return v;}class E implements Has.<E>{get():E{return erased({});}}const x:Has.<E>=new E();let refused=false;try{x.get();}catch(e){refused=e instanceof TypeError;}String(refused);

cases.name: structural membership still rejects an incompatible field
cases.source: class E{get():E{return this;}} interface Stored{value:E;}String(({value:"bad"}) is Stored);

cases.name: an undeclared class is refused at a visible interface assignment
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} class E{get():E{return this;}}const x:Has.<E>=new E();

cases.name: declaration checking still refuses a missing member
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} class E implements Has.<E>{}

cases.name: declaration checking still refuses a wrong result
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} class E implements Has.<E>{get():string{return "bad";}}

cases.name: declaration checking still refuses a wrong parameter
cases.source: interface I{take(v:string):void;}class E implements I{take(v:uint8):void{}}

cases.name: declaration checking still refuses writable capability loss
cases.source: interface I{x:uint8;}class E implements I{get x():uint8{return 1;}}

cases.name: a matching conditional interface retains required members
cases.source: interface Has<T:type>{get():T;} class E implements Has.<E>{get():E{return this;}} interface Box<T:type>{}partial interface Box<const V extends Has.<V>>{required:string;}const x:Box.<E>={};
